_brief: Item 12, Tal 2026-10-03: Phone Call Video / Tel Aviv. Compilation (emotional): six different people answer the sign's question on the red phone. Order per COMPILATION-ORDER: a beaming face inside the first second (the Colombian visitor), a visibly different person every slot, the strongest answer 4th (the young woman: 'my mom is the strongest woman I know... Mom, I love you'), then a grandmother, ending on the older man's 'that's how life looks beautiful. Thank you.' No spoken question from Tal - the sign carries it. NO ZOOMS: one static framing per person.
_framing: LESSONS 81: the man in the cap is framed head-and-shoulders (static 2.67x) because two boys stand right behind his elbow in both of his beats; the older man is framed at a static 2.0x and starts on 'seeing people happy' because a girl walks past him during 'what makes me happy'.
_notes: V1 opened on the mother with her two boys (IMG_5768) and had the father with a toddler on his shoulders (IMG_5728): both OUT in V2 under LESSONS 81 (children who are strangers) - a blurred child in each would have been the beat. Excluded on purpose: IMG_5754 (political: 'IDF soldiers are moral'), the grandmother's 'grandson home safe from the army' and 'Bibi' lines (only her grandkids/health line is used), IMG_5742 (he says 'don't film' - consent), IMG_5715 (getting-married line: the two models disagree on wording and timing), IMG_5737b (a passer-by in front of the lens).
beats: IMG_5751: HOOK - Colombian visitor, beaming from frame one: 'I just want to let the whole world know that Israel makes me happy. Shalom, shalom Israel, shalom the whole world'
IMG_5763: man in the cap: 'the thing that makes me happiest is doing good for people'
IMG_5763: same take, jump cut past 'what else?': 'to bring people happiness, joy, good things, to smile all the time'
IMG_5727: woman in the headwrap: 'a person's happiness... is keeping Shabbat, getting closer to my Father in heaven'
IMG_5725: STRONGEST, slot 4 - 'my mom is the strongest woman I know, she's my whole world... Mom, I love you' - held on her smile
IMG_5743: grandmother, right after the daughter: 'happiness is being with the grandkids and the kids, that they stay healthy'
